summary: Multi-input TOP that routes one texture input to the output using the Index parameter. Fractional indices can blend between inputs, and Extend controls out-of-range or negative index behavior.

key_params.name: index
key_params.note: Selects which input is passed through; the first input is 0.

key_params.name: blend
key_params.note: Blends input images when using floating point values in the Index parameter.

key_params.name: extend
key_params.note: Controls out-of-range and negative index behavior: Clamp, Loop, or ZigZag.

key_params.name: outputresolution
key_params.note: Common TOP control for using, scaling, fitting, limiting, or overriding the selected input resolution.

key_params.name: resolution
key_params.note: Custom output width and height when Output Resolution is Custom Resolution.

key_params.name: resmult
key_params.note: Applies the global TOP resolution multiplier from preferences.

key_params.name: outputaspect
key_params.note: Chooses input, resolution-derived, or custom output aspect ratio.

key_params.name: aspect
key_params.note: Custom aspect ratio pair used when Output Aspect is Custom Aspect.

key_params.name: inputfiltertype
key_params.note: Input image filtering: nearest, linear, or mipmap.

key_params.name: fillmode
key_params.note: Controls how the TOP image fills the node viewer.

key_params.name: filtertype
key_params.note: Viewer filtering: nearest, linear, or mipmap.

key_params.name: npasses
key_params.note: Repeats the TOP operation multiple times by feeding each pass back into the first input.

key_params.name: chanmask
key_params.note: Chooses which RGBA channels the TOP operates on.

key_params.name: format
key_params.note: Pixel format used to store image channel data.

common_gotchas: Index is 0-based: the first input is selected with 0, not 1.
Blend between Inputs only creates smooth crossfades when the Index parameter uses floating point values.
Extend controls negative and out of range indices; Clamp, Loop, and ZigZag can produce very different source selection behavior.
Use Input for resolution, aspect, and pixel format when the switch should preserve the selected texture metadata exactly.
